title: Justice of God
definition: The justice of God means that God always judges and acts according to perfect righteousness, giving what is right according to His holy character.
summary: God's justice is perfect, holy, true, and never corrupt.
christFocus: Jesus bore justice for sinners at the cross and will judge the world in righteousness.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God's justice means He never ignores evil, bends truth, shows corruption, or judges unfairly. His judgments are rooted in His righteous character.

The cross does not bypass justice; it satisfies it. God deals with sin through the sacrifice of Christ so that mercy is not lawlessness.

Final judgment will reveal God's justice publicly. Every hidden evil will be answered, and God will do what is right.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Injustice wounds deeply and can make people wonder whether evil will win. The justice of God matters because it assures believers that God sees, knows, and will judge rightly.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Seek justice without revenge. Trust God with final judgment, pursue righteousness where you can, and find mercy in Christ before the day of judgment.
